candidates.title: Course document upload, move and delete lifecycle
candidates.preconditions: Dedicated course with document tool enabled; synthetic text file; no pre-existing same-name document.
candidates.fixture: Upload the file, move it to a different course-folder path, then delete it through the document tool.

oracle.observable: Uploaded file appears in the course document list; after move it appears at the new path, and after delete it is absent.

novelty.rationale: T04-D maps user/course/exercise/event operations but no document file lifecycle.

baselineOverlap.rationale: T04-D maps user/course/exercise/event operations but no document file lifecycle.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Student without edit permission attempts rename/delete; content remains unchanged.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Legacy file UI and filesystem cleanup need an isolated course fixture.
candidates.uncertainty: Pinned document controller implements upload, move and delete commands with course/group access checks; exact UI outcomes need validation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Upload a synthetic file, move it to a different course-folder path, then delete it.

candidates.title: Group space is inaccessible to a non-member student
candidates.role: Teacher manages; student is not in target group
candidates.preconditions: Course with two groups and one enrolled student assigned only to group A; group B has private content.
candidates.fixture: As the student, open group B directly, then join only if the interface permits self-registration.

oracle.observable: Unauthorized group content is not rendered; self-registration changes access only for the configured open group.

novelty.rationale: Baseline course enrollment/password/denied-course cases cover course-level gates, not group-space membership boundary.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline course enrollment/password/denied-course cases cover course-level gates, not group-space membership boundary.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Repeat against the student's assigned group A and verify access succeeds.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Group membership fixture and legacy session isolation are required.
candidates.uncertainty: Source gates group-space entry with course/group authorization; policy for open self-registration requires exact config confirmation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Group space is inaccessible to a non-member student.

candidates.title: Teacher imports an exercise package into a course
candidates.preconditions: Fresh course with exercise tool enabled and a harmless export-format package containing a unique exercise/question.
candidates.fixture: Use the exercise import command to import the fixture.

oracle.observable: Import reports success and the new exercise/questions appear exactly once in the course list.

novelty.rationale: Baseline creates exercises and questions manually; it does not cover package import.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline creates exercises and questions manually; it does not cover package import.

candidates.title: Tracking controls are teacher-only while exercise attempts remain student-facing
candidates.role: Teacher may edit/track; student may attempt
candidates.preconditions: Tracking enabled; one exercise with a deterministic answer and a separate student account.
candidates.fixture: Submit the exercise as student, then inspect tracking as teacher and as student.

oracle.observable: Student receives the attempt outcome; teacher tracking is available only to an editor when tracking is enabled.

novelty.rationale: Baseline exercise completion and profile-statistics cases may overlap on results; role-specific tracking visibility is not asserted.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline exercise completion and profile-statistics cases may overlap on results; role-specific tracking visibility is not asserted.
